clients.heading: Get Private Base
clients.intro: Private messages and calls on your computer and your phone.
clients.macosNote: This early build is not yet notarized by Apple. In Finder, right-click the app and choose Open, then choose Open again. If macOS still blocks it, go to System Settings, Privacy & Security, and choose Open Anyway.
clients.windowsNote: This early build is not signed yet. If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info, then Run anyway.
clients.androidNote: Android asks if this browser may install apps. Choose Settings, turn on “Allow from this source”, then go back and choose Install.
clients.iosInstallNote: Follow the instructions that come with this build.
clients.iosNote: The iPhone and iPad app is not ready. For now, open Private Base in Safari. To keep it on your Home Screen, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
clients.openFailed: Could not open the download. Try again.
clients.verifyAndroid: Android has no built-in checksum tool. To check the file, copy it to a computer.
clients.verifyIos: To check the file, copy it to a computer.
clients.verifyResult: The result must match the checksum above. If it does not, delete the file.
clients.webAppTitle: Use Private Base in your browser
clients.webAppText: Works in any modern browser. Nothing to install.
clients.trust1Text: Messages, files and calls are end-to-end encrypted in every app and in the browser. Our servers cannot read them.
clients.trust2Text: All files on this page come from dist.718788.xyz. Do not install Private Base from other websites.
clients.trust3Text: Each file has a SHA-256 checksum. Open “Verify download”, compute the checksum of your file, and compare the two values.
clients.errorText: Check your connection and try again. You can also use Private Base in your browser.
